rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Ganesha, revered elephant-headed remover of obstacles.
ANATOMY: one elephant head on potbellied human body, exactly four arms; upper left holds a lasso, upper right battle axe, lower left a sweet, lower right the broken tusk; one full tusk and the other broken; full opaque ceremonial robes [ganesha-c02, ganesha-c04, ganesha-c07, ganesha-c33]
MOMENT: Stride through the temple threshold toward the low viewer, trunk pressing aside a fallen plain stone obstruction, four hands separated and each attribute large and readable
POWER: removal of obstacles shown as a fallen plain stone obstruction being moved clear of a temple threshold; no magical light or invented weapon power [ganesha-c03, ganesha-c29]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera, tight framing and strong foreshortening; subject occupies most of square, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm temple fire from off frame, reflecting on plain ornaments; dramatic rim light and deep shadows.
SURFACE: tangible weathered opaque cloth, tactile skin and stone; dark walnut and antique gold palette.
SETTING: the doorway of a Hindu temple [ganesha-c39]
MOOD: overwhelming majestic dignity, determined expression, awe inspiring active divine presence, never ordinary or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text anywhere including clothing and stone, no pseudo glyphs, no lettering, signature, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity, no explicit gore, no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or runes.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: fully cover the whole chest, shoulders and belly with a high-neck opaque woven long tunic, no visible bare torso at all. Forehead entirely plain, NO painted marks, symbols or glyphs. Plain stone threshold without carved signs. Four arms only.

selection_reason: Dua PNG native telah dibaca. A dipilih: empat tangan terpisah, kapak/lasso di tangan atas dan pecahan gading/manisan masing-masing pada tangan bawah, satu gading patah. B gagal c07: gading dan manisan digabung dalam satu tangan, tangan lain mendorong batu. Tiga percobaan habis, dua kegagalan dipertahankan. Tujuh syarat Sangar A terpenuhi.
